wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.call_back.sho: Bring back everyone waiting in the Other World
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.call_back.des: Every Z Fighter who died and woke in the Other World is sent back to where they woke in the living world, whole and with their halo gone. Refused if nobody is there.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_wish_no_de: Nobody waits in the Other World. The dragon waits for another wish.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_afterlife_: You wake in a pale hall on an island of holystone, high in the sky. A halo hangs over your head. You have died.
Walk the road south. A fortune teller waits at its end.
The Other World doesn't let go of its dead so easily.
The Other World has no more use for you, and lets go.
You wake again among the living. The halo is gone.
%s called you back from the Other World.
%s: "Your fights are written here. Walk the road, fighter. There is a master at its end."
%s: "Death is a door, not a wall. Win the tournament of the dead and the fortune teller will open it for you."
%s: "Nobody stays here forever. The road is not short, though, so train while you walk it."
%s looks through you and says nothing.
%s: "Sneak and come to me empty-handed, and I will teach you."
%s: "One lesson for each stay. Go and use it."
%1$s teaches you: %2$s. (%3$s TP.)
%s: "You are not one of mine yet."
%s: "Champion of the dead. Go back, then."
%1$s: "I can send you back. Win the tournament of the dead for free, or sneak and right-click me holding %2$s emeralds, or with %3$s TP to spare."
%1$s: "You can't pay: %2$s emeralds in your hand, or %3$s TP."
%s: "Paid. Close your eyes."
The bell tolls. %s spirit fighters will meet you, one after the other.
A bout is already on.
You have already won the tournament of the dead.
The bout is called off.
Bout %1$s won. (%2$s TP.)
Champion of the dead! The fortune teller will send you back for nothing.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_demon_laye: The Abyss: the demons' deepest dark
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_demon_mast: %s sneers at you and turns away.
%s: "I teach only those who walk the shadowed path. You still hold to the light."
%s: "Sneak and come to me empty-handed. It will cost you blood."
%s: "Once a day is enough. Come back when the sky has turned."
item.jaymospowers.dreaded_blade.lore: A demon master's blade. It drinks from every wound.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_demon_mast: %s presses his own blade into your hands. "The dark has you now. Let it drink."
